description: Point-in-time members of liquid100, liquid250 or liquid500: the top instruments by trailing 63-trading-day turnover at the latest monthly rebalance on or before as_of. Delisted names stay in the months they qualified for. Required: name. Returns 100 rows by default, up to 500, by rank. Coverage: NSE from 2010-01-04, BSE from 2024-07-08. Tier: needs a Retail or Pro key (https://tejhq.dev/upgrade).

as_of.description: Date to read the universe on. Default: today. Format YYYY-MM-DD.

offset.description: Rows to skip, for paging. Use meta.next_offset from a truncated result.
